simple.meaning: עׇצְמָה (ʻotsmâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “powerfulness ; by extension, numerousness.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עׇצְמָה (H6109) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 40:29, with occurrences in Isaiah, Nahum.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עׇצְמָה (H6109) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עׇצְמָה (H6109) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עׇצְמָה (ʻotsmâh) / H6109 is traced through Isaiah 40:29, Isaiah 47:9, Nahum 3:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
